acquisitionScope: One previously missing catalog root effect/scene/hdzd_eff_spheretrails.prefab.unity3d, 28700 bytes; two dependencies reused local verified bundles. No baseline evidence overwritten.

Six original transforms, five ParticleSystems/renderers; native enabled modules Initial, Emission, Color, Trail preserved including every disabled module, curve, gradient and seed setting. All five children are inactive in the source prefab. ArrowTower f8258 @0x3bd9cd..0x3bd9fd activates exactly child[i] where i==source.CampID; no clamp/fallback for camps outside0..4. Entity13 LineArrow is the endpoint ring. DrawParaLine lazily obtains single LineRendererEntity; it is not an arrow projectile. Entity12 LineRanderCut is initially inactive.

Valid preview line receives supplied player LineColor; invalid line and ring are red. Valid ring _TintColor=(0,.2745098174,.631372571,1). Ring position=end+up*.02. Valid target replaces end with target.position and ring renderer scale=1.25*target.localScale.x; otherwise scale=1.25. Single line SetLine passes allowCut=false and showArrow=false (background only).

For a valid target, LevelControl.IsBossLv (byte+53 getter verified) true AND target.CompareTag(Tag2) multiplies the ring scale by another1.3. Loader sets IsBossLv when a StarInfo.isBoss is present, clears at Enter. Helper exposes expandTaggedTarget as this exact predicate; Boss.Init token100665274 f68533 wasmcode1 @0x14ad873..0x14ad89e explicitly assigns Tags.static20/Tag2 to the Boss model via GameObject.set_tag table53636 (Unity API mapped). Therefore actual initialized Boss target corresponds to Tag2, confirmed by the consumer, not the type name alone.
Clear hides existing line and LineArrow; EndInput also hides cut root. No extra lingering effect or post-release trail is introduced.

MoveCut sets root localPosition=pointer+up*.02 then SetActive(show). Source TrailRenderer time .4, minVertexDistance .002, width curve first value .1755829751,last .0307303816. Entire curve tangents/gradient retained by native serialization. Material xqzd_effect_tuowei02 uses original texture and builtin200 Legacy Shaders/Particles/Additive.

Original type-tree serializedVersion retained at all nested nodes. Every local PPtr remapped to a stable large fileID. Material/mesh placeholders resolved to imported asset GUIDs; source material properties/native mesh coordinates/native bounds retained. Runtime manually pauses and Simulates ParticleSystems once per supplied scaledDelta for engine-independent production adapter replay. TrailRenderer remains the native original renderer.

Capsule radius.03 mask1<<8 (GamePlayer1). Segment endpoint is direct ray-hit tower position if a tower, otherwise ground pointer. Select non-source collider with nearest transform center to source; threshold1000 and <= makes ties choose the last hit. No other collider means valid free ring; nearest non-tower means invalid. Candidate tower snaps endpoint. If candidate differs from direct ray-hit tower (or none), requery source to candidate and reject any collider GameObject other than the two endpoints. No line Direction/IsFrom/active state, grade/capacity, or CheckNewLine enters preview validity. Source selection and final submission remain separate original logic.

Pointer down clears target120. Pointer move computes and caches target120 from the physics/snap result. Pointer up checks stored source116 and target120 nonnull and passes both to f9379 without resampling coordinates, then f4669 clears source116,draw64,sourceTower124 and hides visuals. The implementation clears its no-longer-observable target on end too; next down also clears. BattleView Begin/Move/EndTowerDrag are the exact shared production and editor-replay adapter; final eligibility remains Guide.TryConnect/Simulation.Connect, not preview validity.

unknowns: Exact visual pixel match is not established from original synchronized captures. Original shader names and decompressed programs are retained; current Unity built-in shader is used.
Original ParticleSystem autoRandomSeed retained; particle randomness is not claimed frame-exact.
Native TrailRenderer time/position history follows Unity engine time; editor-only AdvanceFrame without engine updates does not reproduce its temporal trail geometry.
